Hero_Desc_Jubee:
A beast? Insect? No, an elemental commonly found while wandering Elias Forest.
There is a high chance of encountering Jubee as you wander through the forest, but it's best not to bother her too much.
Album_Hate_Jubee: Global warming. Groups that shows up whenever you're feeling down, spouting strange things
Album_Jubee1:
A honey bee elemental from the elemental village. But it's unclear if she's a honey elemental or a honey bee elemental.
It appears the other elementals half-consider Jubee as a pet.
Album_Jubee2:
Jubee incessantly gathers honey but doesn't actually eat it.
She claims it's force of habit, but her diligence suggests otherwise.
Album_Jubee3:
Watching Jubee work nonstop like a worker bee raised suspicions about the existence of a queen bee.
And so, I started secretly following her for a few days.
Album_Jubee4:
I witnessed a stunning scene. There's not just one single Jubee...!
There are so many Jubees. I saw a hair-raising sight
where the Jubees gathered honey, fed it to other Jubees, and cared for the young Jubees.
Album_Jubee5:
I waylaid one Jubee, directly asking her if there was a Queen Jubee.
Although I was inwardly worried, this Jubee chuckled quietly, explaining that there isn't one.
These Jubees live with one another, helping each other out...
Album_Jubee6:
After witnessing Jubee's true nature,
at some point, I started hearing what sounded like flying insects buzzing around me.
Whether I was eating, walking, or sleeping... I kept hearing that sound.
But when I looked around, I didn't see anything. It was so strange.
Album_Jubee7: One night, I had a dream where a Giant Jubee appeared, leading an army of Jubees. They drove out the denizens of Elias and built the Jubee Kingdom. The Giant Jubee nested in the branches of Yggdrasil, creating an enormous beehive. Just as she looked down at me and said, "I am the swar...," I woke up from the dream and found a lump of royal jelly next to me. Was that a warning...?
LoveHero_Jubee:
Are you going to hunt with Jubee?
Let's start by dancing together, bee!
LoveHeroCancel_Jubee:
Master...
Jubee seems like she's going to cry, bee.
Food_ChefNote_Jubee_Hate1:
It's obvious, but Jubee does not eat meat. 
If she did eat meat, Elias' ecosystem would be in danger...
Food_ChefNote_Jubee_Hate2: Jubee rummaged through the food, asking where this plant's honey was, before throwing it away.
Food_ChefNote_Jubee_Like1:
Just as I turned away, Jubee disappeared with the honey. 
She probably took it to go because she likes it, right?
Food_ChefNote_Jubee_Like2:
Jubee was happy to find a dish that was sweeter than honey. 
Saying this food was very good for her, she quickly took it and flew off somewhere.
Food_ChefNote_Jubee_Like3: Jubee thought a bag of this powder would make everyone happy. She held it in her mouth and flew off somewhere.
Food_ChefNote_Jubee_Like4: Initially, she liked the food, thinking it was a juicy fruit with honey. But when I told her I made it, I could sense she was a little disappointed.
Food_ChefNote_Jubee_Like5: She complained it tasted like honey and asking if it was made from it. Only after clearing up the misunderstanding she continued to eat in peace.
Food_ChefNote_Jubee_Like6: Jubee was very satisfied. She mentioned how much easier it would be to collect honey if all trees were this sweet.
Food_ChefNote_Jubee_Like7: Jubee said just one spoonful was enough to fill her up and she wanted to share it with her friends.
Food_ChefNote_Jubee_Like8: Eating with curiosity, Jubee wondered if there was also black honey. "It's a bit bitter, but could replace honey," she commented.
Food_ChefNote_Jubee_Like9: It's as sweet as honey, Jubee said excitedly. She then hurried off to share it with everyone.

I thought of you while flying through the flower garden, bzz.
You really are like a flower, Master, bzz.
You help us Jubees so much, and merely seeing you lifts our spirits, bzz.
For you, all the Jubees are ready to gather honey with everything we have, bzz!
No, we are even ready to give you royal jelly. You deserve that much, bzz.

Whatever anyone says, you are the Jubees' greatest friend, bzz.
Recently, we even formed a Master fan club among ourselves, bzz.
Number 71, 89, 101, 201, and countless other Jubees are cheering for you, bzz.
If anyone bothers you, just tell us, bzz.
The Jubees will race over and give them a sharp lesson, bzz!
